title: Spicy Thai Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and spicy stir fry made with German noodles and Thai-inspired flavors.

ingredients.name: German noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably rice noodles or egg noodles

instructions: Cook German noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together hot sauce and beaten egg for the sauce.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sauce to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
